editorial.description_en: Bare ground in winter: a dark warm neutral, the last step before this group turns to charcoal.
editorial.description_ja: 冬のむき出しの土のような、暗くあたたかい色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.560, C 0.018, h 68.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 冬 (fuyu, winter) + 土 (tsuchi, earth). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Winter Earth" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 冬土. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — hai-suna at ΔE00 5.7, doro-kabe at ΔE00 10.6, kumori-iwa at ΔE00 11.5. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.018 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
